svg.title: Columbia Valley (WA) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Columbia Valley; 2: Yakima; 3: Zillah; 4: Sunnyside; 5: Benton City; 6: Walla Walla; 7: Chelan; 8: Wenatchee; 9: Mattawa; 10: Quincy; 11: Naches; 12: Harrah

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
